summary_en: This phase 2 study tests sFOLFOXIRI, an alternating schedule of FOLFOX and FOLFIRI chemotherapy, with or without nivolumab, in people with HER2-negative advanced gastric or esophageal cancer. Treatment is given into a vein in 28-day cycles, alternating mFOLFOX6 and FOLFIRI with doses on days 1 and 15 of each cycle; optional nivolumab is 240 mg every 2 weeks, and the total study length is not stated. The main outcome measured is objective response rate (ORR); the study also looks at progression-free survival, overall survival, and side effects.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa sFOLFOXIRI, un esquema alterno de quimioterapia FOLFOX y FOLFIRI, con o sin nivolumab, en personas con cáncer avanzado de estómago o esófago HER2 negativo. El tratamiento se administra por vena en ciclos de 28 días, alternando mFOLFOX6 y FOLFIRI con dosis los días 1 y 15 de cada ciclo; el nivolumab opcional es de 240 mg cada 2 semanas, y la duración total del estudio no se indica. El resultado principal que se mide es la tasa de respuesta objetiva (ORR); el estudio también evalúa la supervivencia libre de progresión, la supervivencia global y los efectos secundarios.
who_for: Adenocarcinoma of the esophagus, gastroesophageal junction, or stomach that is metastatic or unresectable, confirmed by tissue or cell testing
HER2 negative tumor by standard local testing
No prior systemic therapy for this cancer in the metastatic setting; up to two prior mFOLFOX6 cycles allowed
not_for: Known brain metastases that are untreated
Another active cancer within the past three years that could affect therapy or imaging
Active systemic corticosteroid use of 10 mg/day prednisone equivalent or more, for those receiving nivolumab
Active autoimmune disease, history of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis, or prior organ or bone marrow transplant, for those receiving nivolumab
